UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd Gatekeeper; if echo '{{amp_url}}' | grep -q '^https://'; then HOST=$(echo '{{amp_url}}' | sed -E 's#^https://##; s#/.*##; s#:.*##'); PORT=$(echo '{{amp_url}}' | sed -E 's#^https://[^:/]+##; s#/.*##; s#^:##'); [ -z \"$PORT\" ] && PORT=443; CERTIFI_PEM=$(PYTHONPATH=pydeps /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import certifi; print(certifi.where())' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n \"$CERTIFI_PEM\" ]; then echo | openssl s_client -connect \"$HOST:$PORT\" -servername \"$HOST\" 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 >> \"$CERTIFI_PEM\" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi"

-c "cd Gatekeeper && cat > tokens.py <<'PYEOF'
token = '{{discord_token}}'
AMPAuth = '{{amp_2fa}}'
AMPUser = '{{amp_user}}'
AMPPassword = '{{amp_password}}'
AMPurl = '{{amp_url}}'
PYEOF
"

-c "cd Gatekeeper && PYTHONPATH=pydeps python3 -c \"import sys, yaml; modules=[m.strip() for m in sys.argv[1].split(',') if m.strip()]; data={'enabled_modules': modules, 'module_settings': {'web': {'host': '0.0.0.0', 'port': sys.argv[6]}, 'authentik': {'client_id': sys.argv[2], 'client_secret': sys.argv[3], 'issuer': sys.argv[4], 'redirect_uri': sys.argv[5]}}}; yaml.safe_dump(data, open('config.yml', 'w'))\" '{{enabled_modules}}' '{{authentik_client_id}}' '{{authentik_client_secret}}' '{{authentik_issuer}}' '{{authentik_redirect_uri}}' '{{web_port}}'"
